name: job-loss-transition
description:
Produces structured transition plans for immediate financial stabilization
after job loss, covering 30-day action plans, benefits continuation
checklists (COBRA timeline, unemployment filing), expense reduction
frameworks, and job search reactivation sequences. Focuses on the
immediate practical steps to stabilize finances and relaunch a career
search within the first 30-90 days.
Use when the user asks about what to do after losing a job, managing
finances during unemployment, or organizing a job loss recovery plan.
Do NOT use for long-term career coaching (use career-development skills),
detailed job search strategy (use job search skills), or mental health
treatment for job loss depression.
